name_zh: DURAN GL45 试剂瓶 100 mL（透明，蓝色 PP 螺旋盖）
description_zh: DURAN Original GL 45 试剂瓶 100 mL（clear），带蓝色 PP 螺旋盖；外径 56 mm、带盖高 105 mm（目录）。盖为独立 link（俯视逆时针 1.25 圈拧下），抓取坐标在瓶颈/肩部（Franka ≤ 74 mm）。

coordinate_system.frame: 资产根坐标：底面占地中心，z=0 为放置面；+X 向右，+Y 向后，正面朝 −Y；四元数按 (x, y, z, w)

duran_gl45_clear.reference: DWK Life Sciences, DURAN Original GL 45 laboratory bottle, clear (e.g. https://www.dwk.com/na/duran-original-gl-45-laboratory-bottle-clear-with-screw-cap-and-pouring-ring-pp-blue-1000-ml-218015455); dimension table also listed by Parkes Scientific (https://parkesscientific.com/p/duran-21801-original-laboratory-bottles-with-high-temperature-closures-red)
duran_gl45_clear.locator: cat. 21801 24 5x (100 mL), 21801 36 5x (250 mL), 21801 44 5x (500 mL), 21801 54 5x (1000 mL), with screw cap + pouring ring PP blue; table columns capacity / thread / OD / height
duran_gl45_clear.note: OD x height with cap and pouring ring: 100 mL 56 x 105 mm, 250 mL 70 x 143 mm, 500 mL 86 x 181 mm, 1000 mL 101 x 230 mm; the bottle-only versions are 5 mm lower (100/138/176/225 mm). Read from the vendor/distributor tables via web search, accessed 2026-10-22 (dwk.com 403 to direct download).

gl45_thread.reference: DIN 168-1 (knuckle threads for glass containers); GL 45 values as quoted from 'Guide to World Screw Threads' in https://www.practicalmachinist.com/forum/threads/gl-45-threads.264357/
gl45_thread.locator: GL 45: neck major diameter 45.00 mm, pitch 4 mm, thread depth 1.36 mm
gl45_thread.note: DIN 168-1 is paywalled; the secondary quotation is used for the neck major diameter (45 mm) and pitch (4 mm). accessed 2026-10-22.

duran_gl45_cap.reference: DWK DURAN screw cap PP blue GL 45 (type K, DWK 293032803), distributor listing https://www.labfriend.com.au/dwk-duran-screw-caps-pp-blue-gl45-k
duran_gl45_cap.note: Blue PP GL 45 screw cap: 58 mm outside diameter, 27 mm high. accessed 2026-10-22.

iso3585.reference: ISO 3585:1998 Borosilicate glass 3.3 - Properties (DURAN is borosilicate glass 3.3)
iso3585.note: Density of borosilicate glass 3.3 = 2230 kg/m3, used to compute empty glass masses from the modelled wall volume.

pp_hdpe_density.reference: typical resin densities: PP 900 kg/m3, HDPE 950 kg/m3, PS 1050 kg/m3, PE 950 kg/m3
pp_hdpe_density.note: Used only to compute the mass of plastic parts from their modelled volume; the grade-to-grade spread is about +/-2 %.

wall_assumption.reference: wall and bottom thicknesses of containers / caps
wall_assumption.note: Manufacturers do not publish wall thicknesses; glass bottles 2.5 mm wall / 4 mm bottom, plastic tubes 0.8-1.0 mm, caps 2-3 mm, chosen from typical pressed-glass and moulded-PP practice. They set the empty mass and the interior volume (the computed brim volume is checked against the nominal capacity).

neck_profile_estimate.reference: product photographs of the same catalogue items (vendor pages)
neck_profile_estimate.note: Shoulder height, collar and thread-zone heights are estimated from product photos and scaled to the documented OD / height; the documented values (OD, height, thread) are kept exactly.

closure_turns.note: Turns until a screw cap is free: GL 45 1.25 turns (pitch 4 mm, ~5 mm engagement), SPI 400-type finishes 1 turn, 415-type 2 turns, vial and tube caps 1-1.5 turns. No manufacturer publishes these; the detach rule only needs a threshold.

robot_access.reference: robot-access constraints of the Franka arm set-up for the storage tasks, 2026-10-22
robot_access.locator: Franka gripper <= 80 mm open (grasp zones <= 74 mm), hand collision 37 mm above TCP, top-down access, bench-shelf pitch >= 11 cm and >= 25 cm free above bottle tops
robot_access.note: Used to place grasp frames and the bench-shelf slot layout.

body.function_zh: 盛放试剂/样品；提供抓取部位、倾倒口与螺纹颈
body.physical_meaning_zh: borosilicate_3_3 壳体；外径 56.0 mm、本体高 100.0 mm；内腔为 LiquidContents 的计数区
body.passive_reason: 被动容器/器具：只提供几何、容积、质量与抓取/放置坐标；盛装物由宿主的物质账本记录，倾倒和搬运属于机器人技能。

height_with_cap_m.meaning_zh: 带盖总高（目录或由目录推得）

brim_capacity_m3.meaning_zh: 建模内腔到瓶口的满口容量（由壁厚假设计算）

mass_kg.meaning_zh: 该 link 的仿真质量（由建模壁厚体积 58.0 cm3 × borosilicate_3_3 密度 2230 kg/m3 计算）

cap.function_zh: 密封瓶口；拧松后整体取下，可放回再拧紧
cap.physical_meaning_zh: pp 螺旋盖 Ø58.0×27.0 mm；GL45 螺纹
cap.passive_reason: 被动部件：开合/旋下由机器人抓握+意图触发（touch + intent），资产本身没有执行器、传感器或自驱动 API。

mass_kg.meaning_zh: 该 link 的仿真质量（由建模体积 30.32 cm3 × pp 密度计算）

closure.state.meaning_zh: 盖的场景状态：拧紧 / 已拧松未脱离 / 已取下（由场景或宿主按 closure.rule 记录）

joint_cap.mapping_zh: 正方向 = 俯视逆时针 = 拧松；累计 1.25 圈（7.854 rad）后盖脱离螺纹（touch + intent：夹住盖 + 腕部转动即记账，不靠接触物理拧出）

mouth.meaning_zh: 瓶口：倒出/加入液体或粉末（开盖后）
connection_constraints: 盖必须为 detached 状态才能倒出或加入
倾倒属于机器人技能，转移量由宿主账本记录

closure.thread.meaning_zh: 螺旋盖的开合规则（touch + intent）：夹住盖并转动的累计角度达到阈值即脱离；反向同角度即拧紧。不模拟螺纹接触力。
equations: state = detached if cumulative_unscrew_rad >= detach_after_rad (cap grasped)
state = closed if cap at cap_seat and cumulative_screw_rad >= detach_after_rad
limitations: 不计螺纹摩擦、密封圈与扭矩；单臂开盖要求容器被存放位或夹具固定。
被动容器：没有主动硬件 API；开盖、倾倒、搬运属于机器人技能，内容物由宿主物质账本记录。
外径/高度/容量/螺纹/盖尺寸为目录值；肩部与颈圈比例为照片估计；壁厚与底厚为假设，空瓶质量由此计算。
开盖用 touch + intent 规则（closure.thread），不模拟螺纹接触；拧下后盖作为 parts/cap.urdf 独立刚体。
model.urdf 的瓶身碰撞为壁环盒 + 底盘（可装粒子液体）；只记账的存放容器可用 model_solid.urdf。

chemistry_lab.labware.model: DURAN Original GL 45 laboratory bottle, clear, 100 mL, PP screw cap + pouring ring

interior.note_zh: LiquidContents 计数圆柱可取 radius_m / floor_m / height_m；精确液位用 volume_table（高度 m → 体积 mL）

closure.rule_zh: 开盖 = 夹住盖（cap_grasp）+ 腕部绕盖轴正向累计转动 ≥ detach_after_rad → 盖与瓶身分离为独立刚体（parts/cap.urdf），盖可放到台面；盖回 = 盖对准 cap_seat + 反向转动同样角度 → 重新固连。容器需由存放位/夹具固定（单臂）。

grasp.note_zh: 俯抓瓶颈/肩部（手掌碰撞面在 TCP 上方 37 mm，须高于盖顶）；带盖与开盖后都可用

pre_grasp.note_zh: 抓取前悬停点：竖直下降到 grasp

place.note_zh: 放置时 TCP 在物体坐标中的位置（= grasp）；目标位姿 = 存放位/仪器位 ⊗ place

cap_grasp.note_zh: 盖中心高度；夹住后绕 +Z 正向转动 = 拧松

cap_grasp_local.note_zh: 同一抓取点，用盖自身坐标表示（盖已取下时）

cap_seat.note_zh: 盖 link 原点（盖底中心）拧紧时在瓶身坐标中的位姿；重新盖上 = 盖原点对准此位姿后反向转动

pour_lip.note_zh: +X 侧瓶口外缘；倾倒时最低点（Pour 原语按此计算越过目标杯沿的高度）

chemistry_lab.labware.mass_evidence: computed from modelled wall volume x material density (wall thickness assumed)
chemistry_lab.labware.storage_note_zh: 试剂/缓冲液/标准溶液/溶剂
